NordicTrail Gear Refund Policy

Customers may return unused products within 30 days of purchase for a full refund.

Used hiking boots, tents, backpacks, and jackets are not eligible for a refund unless the product is defective.

Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5 business days after the returned item is inspected.

Items returned after 30 days are not eligible for a refund.
